Job Title: Data Analyst
Experience: 3-6 years
Location: Bengaluru, on-site 5 days a week. No remote option.
Mandatory Skills:
- SQL
- Python
- Tableau
- Microsoft Excel

Good to have:
- Statistics
- Power BI
- Google Analytics
- Looker

Responsibilities:
- Work as part of a cross-functional analytics team at Asterion Insights, a fast-growing analytics services firm serving e-commerce and fintech clients.
- Own end-to-end data analysis projects: extract and transform data using SQL, develop reusable Python scripts for data processing, and build interactive dashboards in Tableau to communicate findings to stakeholders.
- Produce accurate, timely reports and dashboards using Microsoft Excel for financial and operational metrics; implement best practices for versioning and documentation.
- Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders and engineering to translate business questions into analytical tasks and actionable recommendations.
- Validate data quality, perform root-cause analyses, and design tests to ensure metric reliability.
- Provide ad-hoc analyses and support month-end reporting; present insights in clear, concise formats to non-technical audiences.
- Contribute to improving internal analytics processes and tooling, mentor junior analysts, and help define data governance standards.
